folds.note: search fitness = TRAIN side of fold 0 (initial block); fold TEST sides are read only in the final survival stage (never in this probe)

search.note: DEAP/niche evolution gets min(fraction * n_candidates, pop * (gens + 1)) unique evaluations; the rest is random fill round-robin over all available archetypes

cost.note: TemporalEvaluator evaluates BASE and COMBINED_ADVERSE; lean search reads COMBINED_ADVERSE only. Slippage of non-GER40 markets is scaled by median_atr / ger40_median_atr_price

sizing.note: GER40 = V1 values exactly. Other markets: min/max_risk_pts and slippage scaled by ATR ratio, contract_size/lot_step/min_lot from the MarketSpec

reference.note: median M5 ATR14 (price units) on the GER40 search-train side, measured by the 2026-09-30 smoke
